title: Eurostat euro-area HICP flash estimate, October 2026 — published six days after the ECB's 10-29 decision
source: EST: ecb.europa.eu statistical release calendar for HICP (press/calendars/statscal/ges/html/sthicp), fetched direct 2026-09-05 by ecb-decision-2026-10-29's initial research: the Oct-2026 flash is listed at 04/11/2026 15:00 CET. The same calendar's Sep-2026 flash date (02/10/2026) was met exactly, which supports the rest of its schedule. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit; not re-fetched today. Checked 2026-10-13
notes: DISCOVERED during the ecb-decision-2026-10-29 D-16 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-10-13). It is the first euro-area inflation print after the ECB's October meeting, which therefore decides without it; the print feeds the December 17 ECB decision, where the terminal-rate question is priced to resolve. Impact LOW and symbols empty, deliberately: no tracked name carries euro-inflation exposure. It lands 15:00 CET = 10:00 ET on 11-04 (EU and US both on standard time by then), the same morning as ADP and ISM Services. Proposed as an estimate; it widens caution and licenses nothing.
